title: Project service discovery
description: Find services by the authorized physical project root, including saved declarations and observed listeners.

title: Individual service inspection
description: Inspect one service without exposing another project or private process arguments.

title: Availability and freshness
description: Show URL, owner, listening and publication separately; preserve previous data on failed refresh and label it stale.

title: Choose a Station project
description: Bind a place to a stable project identity and its authorized physical folder.

title: Compare place and folder access
description: Show app membership and Unix folder grants separately; neither implies the other.

title: Project toolbox
description: Open declared shell, REPL and desktop tools; executable and working directory come from host profiles.

title: Project previews
description: Start a bounded project preview and show its actual readiness and endpoint.

title: Service lifecycle
description: Start, stop, restart, boot-enable, withdraw publication or remove the saved declaration with separate grants.

title: Updates and rollback
description: Select an admitted immutable release; keep the previous version and report activation outcome.

title: Bounded service logs
description: Read authorized, bounded and redacted log excerpts beside the failed work.

title: Project runtime health
description: Project-scoped process, memory, swap, failed-unit and history observations.

title: Running runtime versus pin
description: Show the observed executable and build separately from env.bl declarations.

title: Document VM pools
description: Move or split document realms and manage pool limits under the owning account.

description: Project authorized incoming handoffs alongside tasks and reviews; source remains Station.

title: Handoff to task or review
description: Create explicit work with a stable source link and duplicate-safe conversion.

title: Topics and place routes
description: Follow a topic hierarchy and bind receiver-owned folders or a thread override.

description: Send tasks, documents, decisions and results with world, ID and source basis.

title: Resolve the live source

description: Reply to the original audience with result references; later incoming replies reopen recipient work.

title: Promote received knowledge

title: Team context inside Station

title: Teammate onboarding

title: Scoped agent context

title: Bounded procedure jobs

title: Code output into review
description: Retain repository and commit provenance; publish only the explicitly accepted output.

title: Operational workflow conditions
description: Fresh readiness or failure observations inform typed actions; uncertainty requires inspection.

title: External client exchange

title: Approved model connections
description: Use constrained gateway operations while credentials stay with their existing owner.

title: Gateway usage observations
description: Show relevant usage, refusals and connection metadata without exposing prompts or secrets.

title: Project recovery coverage
description: Show coverage, the last complete backup and separately scoped restore-test evidence.

title: Explain network state
description: Show provider, publication and observation freshness; missing observations remain unknown.

title: Capability compatibility
description: Distinguish absent grant, incompatible interface, stale observation and unavailable provider.

title: Operator attention in Today

title: Recurring company tasks
description: Implement durable timezone-aware scheduling, stable occurrence keys and restart/skip semantics.

title: Outbound reports and CRM evidence
description: Add durable attributed totals, expected revisions, corrections and reviewed identity matching.

title: Company funnel and progress
description: Connect the checked model and preview to real business commands and authorized live views.

title: Browser activity helper
description: Implement pairing, revocation, packaging, observed evidence and replay/reconciliation.

title: Semantic release status
description: Bind an explicit provider receipt to a release; a listening socket cannot prove deployment or commercial state.
